rewards: Ability to Teleport to Dondakan's Rock using a Ring of Wealth.

st.t: Bring 5 coins to the Keldagrim tunnel entrance east of Rellekka, just south of the Polar Hunter area (fairy ring DKS). Go in and through the tunnel in the cave wall. Pay the Dwarven Ferryman, not the Dwarven Boatman, to cross the water. Run north and east across the bridge, then west past the second wooden bridge, and talk to Dondakan in the north of the mine.
s: Why are you firing a cannon at a wall?
So why were you trying to get through the rock again?

st.t: Take the Dwarven Ferryman back across the water, then travel to Keldagrim with the Dwarven Boatman nearby. Talk to the Dwarven Engineer in the Trading Consortium's palace smithing shop in west Keldagrim.
Talk to Rolad at the Ice Mountain entrance to the Dwarven Mine. If you don't have an ammo mould, buy one from Nulodion whilst you're here.
Enter the Dwarven Mine.
Search the mine carts for a page.
Kill scorpions for a page.
Mine low level rocks for a page.
Talk to Rolad again. When he asks for the book back, choose to lie so you can keep it.
Read the entire dwarven lore book.
Return to Dondakan with the book and a gold bar.
Use a gold bar on Dondakan.
Use a gold bar on a furnace to make a gold cannonball.
Use a gold cannon ball on Dondakan.
s: Yes, I'm sure this will crack open the rock.

st.t: Talk to Dondakan after he fires the cannon ball.
s: So you want to... fire me into the rock?
I can't argue with that, shoot me in!

st.t: Read the last page of the dwarven lore book again for a base schematic.
Talk to the Dwarven Engineer in west Keldagrim.
Use 3 gold bars on an anvil to make a gold helmet.
Go down the White Wolf Tunnel stairs, north of Catherby, and talk to Khorvak in the pub inside the tunnel.
s: No, I've had enough of buying drinks for people!

st.t: Assemble the schematics: long-press Dondakan's schematic in your inventory and choose Assemble. Select one piece at a time, then turn and move it until the drawing matches the solved picture.
Wear your gold helmet and prepare for a fight. Return to Dondakan the same way as before: through the Keldagrim tunnel east of Rellekka and across the water with the Dwarven Ferryman.
Mine at least 6 gold ores. Mine 15 if you want the Avatar to be level 75 instead of level 125. Keep the ores in your inventory for the boss fight. Do not remove your gold helmet.
Go to the centre of the area. Walk through the first wall of flames, then long-press the second wall of flame and choose Talk-to.
Kill the avatar. Make sure to keep the gold ores in your inventory.
Talk to Dondakan to finish the quest.
